captions.text: Sol 1: just the two landing pods
Month 1: the pressurised rover rolls off the cargo pod
Month 3: small fission reactors give power day and night, even in storms
Month 7: the plant starts making oxygen and methane from CO2 air and ice
Month 9: a pressurised walkway joins the pod and the habitat
Month 14: walls of bagged soil block some of the radiation
Month 16: a big dish to talk to Earth
Month 21: the ascent vehicle's tanks keep filling
Month 26: Earth and Mars line up again - the next ships can launch
